remarks: Discover the charm of this 1920s Farmhouse Colonial, freshly painted and ready to welcome you home. With its classic facade and delightful curb appeal, this home invites you in through a covered front porch, perfect for quiet mornings or evening relaxation. Step inside to a spacious living room, complete with a cozy wood-burning stove set against an exposed brick backdrop, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The main level includes an open dining area that flows into a well-equipped kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space. A dedicated laundry area on the main level adds to the home's convenience. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is generously sized and includes dual walk-in closets. The second bedroom is flexible, easily adapted as a home office, artist studio, or guest room. A well-organized basement provides additional storage. Step out onto a large deck, extending your living space outdoors and overlooking a level, fenced yard-ideal for entertaining, gardening, or play. You're just minutes away from popular shopping centers, including the Norwalk Shopping Plaza and The SoNo Collection, providing a range of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Short distance to Calf Pasture Beach. Easy access to major highways like I-95 and Route 7 makes commuting a breeze. This residence beautifully combines vintage charm with practical updates, presenting a unique opportunity to enjoy classic Colonial style with modern amenities in a location that truly has it all!
